tool_input.description: Inspect events CSV head and row count

tool_input.command:
echo "=== distinct categories ===" ; cut -d',' -f5 data/events.csv | sort | uniq -c
echo "=== rows with empty amount (field 4 empty) ===" ; grep -nE '^[^,]*,[^,]*,[^,]*,,' data/events.csv | head -40

awk -F',' 'NR>1 && $4!="" && ($4+0>10000 || $4+0<0){print NR": "$1" amount="$4}' data/events.csv 2>&1 | head -40
echo "=== count out of range ==="
awk -F',' 'NR>1 && $4!="" && ($4+0>10000 || $4+0<0){c++} END{print c}' data/events.csv 2>&1
echo "=== out of range amounts ===" ; awk -f .tmp/find_oor.awk data/events.csv ; echo "=== count ===" ; awk -f .tmp/find_oor.awk data/events.csv | wc -l

tool_input.content:
BEGIN { FS=","; OFS="," }
NR==1 { print > validfile; next }
{
  nf = NF
  rid = $1
  amount = $4
  cat = $5
  valid = 1
  # rule: well-formed (5 fields)
  if (nf != 5) valid = 0
  # rule 1: amount present
  if (amount == "") valid = 0
  # rule 2: amount in [0,10000]
  else {
    a = amount + 0
    if (a < 0 || a > 10000) valid = 0
  }
  # rule 3: category whitelist
  if (cat != "grocery" && cat != "travel" && cat != "salary" && cat != "rent" && cat != "other") valid = 0

  if (valid == 1) print $0 > validfile
  else print rid > rejectfile
}

tool_input.command:
echo "=== field-count distribution ===" ; awk -F',' '{print NF}' data/events.csv | sort | uniq -c
awk -v validfile=.tmp/valid.csv -v rejectfile=.tmp/rejected.txt -f .tmp/validate.awk data/events.csv
echo "=== valid rows (incl header) ===" ; wc -l .tmp/valid.csv
echo "=== rejected count ===" ; wc -l .tmp/rejected.txt
echo "=== rejected ids ===" ; sort .tmp/rejected.txt

mkdir -p submission
hops fg create events7c0498 --version 1 \
  --primary-key row_id \
  --event-time event_time \
  --online \
  --features "row_id:string,account_id:string,event_time:bigint,amount:double,category:string" \
  --description "Events validated against data contract (amount present & in [0,10000], category in allowed set)" \
  --json 2>&1

tool_input.description: Insert valid rows into feature group

tool_input.command:
sort .tmp/rejected.txt | awk 'BEGIN{printf "{\"rejected\": ["} {printf "%s\"%s\"", (NR>1?", ":""), $1} END{print "]}"}' > submission/answers.json
cat submission/answers.json
echo "=== validate JSON has 49 ids ==="
grep -o 'R[0-9]*' submission/answers.json | wc -l

hops fg info events7c0498 --version 1 --json 2>&1 | grep -Ei 'online|name|version|primary|event_time' | head
echo "=== preview ==="
hops fg preview events7c0498 --version 1 --n 5 --json 2>&1 | tail -40
tool_input.description: Confirm online flag and preview data
